composition_label: review -> adaptive -> basic:research -> faq | energy and utilities

construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated reference implementation built from the supplied task

shared_schema.context: Explicitly synthetic grid assets/topology, interval CSV, SCADA telemetry JSON, outage reports, sourced emissions, document requirements, sources, learner profile, questions
shared_schema.output: Same envelope with protected context and accumulated deterministic stage results
shared_schema.validation: One validate() layer checks envelope, industry rules, referential integrity, bounded entities, and deterministic provenance replay at every handoff
shared_schema.error_contract: One JSON object with status=error; exit 2; no raw input or identifiers echoed

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Traceable requirement gaps select modules and generate research questions
Validated user/gap research questions, onboarding topics, original gap IDs
Ranked verbatim evidence, source citations, declared-claim conflicts and insufficient-evidence states

behavior.review: Term-level evidence with exact source quotes and persistent gaps; seasonal kWh summaries; safety priorities; sourced/unit-bearing emissions
behavior.adaptive: Prerequisite-first ordering, completed-topic skipping, experience-specific depth and preference-specific explanations
behavior.research: General-purpose deterministic lexical retrieval over supplied source text; up to three evidence excerpts per question; conflicts checked across all retrieved sources; bounded decision guidance
behavior.faq: Only verbatim grounded source excerpts; explicit abstention for absent or conflicting evidence
industry_rules: Critical asset and corresponding device identifiers pseudonymized consistently before review output, including CSV, telemetry, topology and source text
Declared safety rules must prioritize life safety P1, then essential service P2, then routine P3
Emissions require finite nonnegative values, kgCO2e or tCO2e units and a supplied source
Meter timestamps are timezone-aware and meter/time pairs unique; telemetry units and device/asset relationships validated
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Fictitious two-node grid, fictitious substation/device identifiers and plausible winter heating consumption
behavior.llm: No LLM step, injected callable or provider needed

limitations: Term presence does not establish requirement satisfaction outside this demonstration
Onboarding completion is supplied, not independently verified
Claim conflicts cover explicitly structured claims, not arbitrary prose contradictions
Review gaps persist even if onboarding completes
Source emissions figures are preserved with provenance, not independently audited

test_outcomes.cli: Passed: example prints one JSON object, status ok, stage faq, exit 0
test_outcomes.error_cli: Validated malformed JSON, invalid schemas, duplicate JSON keys, oversized numbers, missing file and missing arguments: JSON status error, exit 2
test_outcomes.deliverable_inventory: Verified exactly the four requested files, with no bytecode cache or additional artifacts
